newsitem.title: USA: TWA sets new St. Louis, New York flights.
newsitem.headline: TWA sets new St. Louis, New York flights.

text.p: Trans World Airlines Inc on Wednesday said it would add flights to its schedule in St. Louis and at John F. Kennedy International Airport in New York during the next two months.

The carrier plans to add a second daily flight linking St. Louis and Gatwick Airport near London as of May 15, using Boeing 767 jetliners. The summer schedule previously featured only one flight a day to Gatwick from St. Louis, TWA said.
The company also said it would not offer flights from St. Louis to Madrid as planned this summer because it had not received the necessary slot allocations from the Spanish government.
TWA, the seventh-largest U.S. air carrier, is resuming daily service from New York to Lisbon and Barcelona as well as daily non-stop service to Seattle, effective March 15.
Its shares were off 9/16 at 7-3/8 in early afternoon trading.
